title: Lane Lifecycle Event v1
description: Immutable lane lifecycle event for the promotion and consumption authority. Each event is appended to an append-only JSONL ledger, carries an integrity digest, a predecessor digest binding it to the prior event in the chain, and references lane identity, mission identity, base revision, and bounded evidence.

lane_id.description: Lane identifier — stable across all events for the same lane.

base_revision.description: Git revision SHA at lane creation — used for stale base detection.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event creation.

prior_event_digest.description: Integrity digest of the immediately prior event in this lane's chain. Null for the first event.

integrity_digest.description: SHA256 integrity digest covering all event data (excluding this field).

claimed_path_evidence_sha256.description: SHA256 of claimed-path evidence at lane creation.

proof_bundle_sha256.description: SHA256 of the proof bundle submitted with a readiness request.

validation_decision_sha256.description: SHA256 of the validation decision evidence.

refusal_reason.description: Refusal reason for refused or promotion_refused transitions.

promotion_target.description: Target branch or corridor for promotion.

promotion_source_sha256.description: SHA256 of the promotion source evidence.
